name: water_sources
summary: Every canister, tank, device and pipe network holding water, polluted water or steam, with location, pressure, temperature and water in moles, litres and hydration; largest first. Lists 15. Read only.

help.text: Room and world air, bodies, organs, bottles and packets (consumables lists those) are left out. Sources under min_mol (default 1 mol, 0.018 L) are skipped. Water is drunk through a water bottle filler or a drinking fountain on a pipe network; polluted water needs a water purifier first and steam must condense. owner.kind is item, structure, dynamic (a portable tank) or pipe_network.
help.keys: sources [{kind, owner, atmosphere_id, volume_l, pressure_kpa, temperature_k, water}], count, totals {liquid_mol, liquid_l, hydration, polluted_mol, polluted_l, ...}, min_mol, local_player {reference_id, display_name, position}.

timing.text: A pipe network is listed from the moment it exists, even while paused; a thing's own atmosphere made after the last atmospherics tick (a canister spawned while paused) is listed from the next tick on.

min_mol.description: Skip sources holding less water, polluted water and steam together; default 1 mol.

min_moles.description: Old name of min_mol, still read; min_mol wins.
